notes.5b4d7a5b7e702c23: The English gloss is cut short ("ering", for "offering"); translated as the infinitive of offering freewill offerings.

uncertain.64a61cab67a1fbcd: Lam 4:7: nazir here read as "ones of high rank"; whether it means princes/nobles or Nazirites is debated.
uncertain.55b4bdc4903a5354: Gen 49:26 / Deut 33:16: nazir as "prince" or "one separated/consecrated" is debated.
uncertain.b7aaca732c9ba2b7: Isa 52:15: yazzeh, "startle" or "sprinkle", is a long-debated reading.
uncertain.281e4b20b89311b4: Lev 25:5: nazir for the unpruned vine is a rare, figurative sense.
uncertain.1c54e1a473299883: Lev 25:11: nazir for the unpruned vine is a rare, figurative sense.
uncertain.e7e895e8e77952ce: Job 28:4: nachal as a mine "shaft" is a rare sense; the verse is obscure.
uncertain.b211b83cac3279b0: Num 24:6: nechalim, "wadis/valleys" or "palm groves", is debated.
uncertain.3ae795cba5b3548b: Ezek 16:36: nechoshet here ("lust", "filthiness" or "copper/money") is a debated sense.
uncertain.aa5df4a1258172f0: Zeph 1:11: netile kesef, "weighers" or "those laden with silver"; a rare word.
uncertain.dad2ea6b8f2bbf41: Exod 30:34: nataf, the gum called "stacte"; the substance is not identified with certainty.
uncertain.a1b876e67ed7e56a: Gen 37:25 / 43:11: nekhot, glossed "spice"; tragacanth gum or another resin is uncertain.
uncertain.17c11c55e0bdea5a: Ezek 7:11: noah, a hapax glossed "distinction"; its sense is uncertain.
uncertain.9cecbc658fbe7270: Ps 5 title: nechilot, "flutes" or another musical term, is uncertain.
uncertain.2f40229aacc76af6: Exod 15:2: anvehu, "I will glorify him" or "I will make him a habitation", is debated.
uncertain.344a275086e1e1e1: Hab 2:5: yinveh, "stays at home / rests", a rare and debated word.
uncertain.876f3ad75cbdf0ac: Ps 68:12: navat bayit, "the beautiful woman of the house" or "she who stays at home", is debated.
uncertain.38699d4cae666109: Hos 13:14: nocham, "compassion" or "repentance", is a debated hapax.
uncertain.d72e099816841ce4: Job 16:5: nid, "condolence/moving (of lips)", a rare word.
uncertain.87136fd2ff2cd184: 1 Sam 7:2: vayinnahu, "they mourned/lamented after", a rare form whose sense is debated.
